privacy_scope: population and seed summaries, anonymous counts and costs only; no subject/trial rows, identifiers, predictions or weights

method.graph: observed_S1_S2_12D -> causal_TCN64 -> parallel18D_and24D_heads -> concatenated42D -> framewise_MLP -> six_angles
method.input: measured S1 left shank and S2 right shank ACC/GYRO native xyz SI only
method.signal_reference: measured S3 waist, S4 left foot and S5 right foot ACC/GYRO native xyz with accepted masks
method.position_reference: eight optical landmarks relative to bilateral hip midpoint; engineering proxy; not hardware sensor centers or clinical JCS
method.inference: full causal parent sequence, independent reset, no window fusion, observed x only
method.aggregation: within each patient equal trials, then equal three seeds, then equal eight patients
method.seed_SD: sample SD across three equal-patient seed means, ddof=1; not patient SD or confidence interval
method.physical_metric_rule: signal SI scores only S=1; position mm scores only P=1; no latent physical ranking
method.direction_counts: negative difference = lower error; ties use absolute tolerance 1e-12; patient-by-seed cells are not independent participants

costs.runtime_note: sum of individual fit wall seconds is a compute ledger, not elapsed campaign duration; CPU-only two threads per fit
costs.supervision_note: channel seconds and landmark seconds are reference annotation/measurement support, not independent samples; shared file/scaler preprocessing remains common even when an auxiliary gradient is disabled

boundaries: same eight people, new trials development analysis; not LOSO, new-patient generalization or blind validation
all three prespecified seeds and all four arms included; no best-seed or checkpoint selection
fixed .25 auxiliary weights in simultaneous training only; negative evidence does not exclude all curricula, weights or architectures
None is the same strict 42D graph with untyped latent heads; do not pool with old direct single-seed pilot or literature-baseline TEST results
position is an optical landmark engineering proxy; angles are engineering labels; no hardware sensor position or clinical JCS claim
all intermediate SI/mm metrics apply only to the actually supervised block
seed direction counts and patient direction counts are descriptive, without p values or causal mechanism claims
no raw records, individual patients, individual trials, predictions, checkpoints or absolute private paths in this export
